text:
jess-runner: noticed p99 intra-rack GPU RPC latency spike after the ToR firmware push ~30m ago. Jobs hitting kvstore timeouts, rack-7/az-a primarily. Any network eyes? :eyes:

samir-sre: I see a bunch of pod restarts / RPC deadlines from gpu-prod nodes in rack-7, posting one error snippet: ```rpc error: code=DeadlineExceeded desc="context deadline exceeded"```

jess-runner: impact looks like ~28 GPU pods degraded, scheduler rescheduled some to other racks, autoscaler kicked up ~40% — cost spike and cross-AZ egress.

tina-net: running quick checks. Can you paste `kubectl get nodes -l rack=rack-7 -o wide`? Also doing `ip link` and quick tor links audit.

jess-runner: pasted output inline: ```NODE           STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION   INTERNAL-IP      RACK
gpu-node-71    Ready    gpu      120d  v1.27.3   10.2.71.12       rack-7
...```

tina-net: tcpdump on a test pod -> ToR shows a lot of retransmits and duplicate ACKs, then session resets. sample: ```08:42:13.123456 IP 10.2.71.12.40934 > 10.2.71.13.443: Flags [P.], seq 1:1025, ack 1, win 229, length 1024 (DF)``` then many `Resent` and `RST`.

tina-net: also ran `ip link show` on host and switched Tor: host mtu=1500 but tor uplink mtu=9216 on peer. MTU mismatch on a subset of leaf ports. That's a red flag for RDMA traffic.

max-ops: `ibv_devinfo` on node shows IB link down fallback: ```link_layer: Ethernet
phys_state: PORT_DOWN
transport: IB
device 'mlx5_0': active speed 10 (expected 100)
``` so likely firmware change dropped RDMA paths and stack fell back to TCP, but kernel and ToR path still assuming jumbo frames.

samir-sre: addition — the ToR L4 sticky-hash behavior is oscillating after the firmware. Hash mapping for 5-tuple changed between fabric members causing ECMP asymmetry; connections are flipping between forwarding planes mid-session. That + MTU mismatch explains heavy retransmits.

jess-runner: that matches the pod logs: partial responses, then GRPC timeouts when reconnected to different backend.

tina-net: quick mitigation options: 1) force single-path for affected prefix (route pin) on fabric for rack-7, 2) temporarily disable ToR L4 sticky hashing (reduces session churn but may affect perf), 3) patch host MTU to 9k for pods (risky live).

max-ops: short term I can cordon/evacuate the worst nodes and drain GPU pods to rack-9. Will create cordon plan. Also propose pausing autoscaler to avoid cross-AZ scale.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for `tor-fw` canary (version 2026-03-18-3): rollback job `rollback-tor-fw-2026-03-18-3` triggered by @max-ops at 1803456840.

tina-net: while rollback runs I'll apply a soft fix: update ToR config to prefer single-hash path for gpu CIDR and disable per-flow seed randomization. Doing now — will monitor.

samir-sre: running `conntrack -L | grep 10.2.71` shows high churn, lots of `SYN_RECV` to `ESTABLISHED` to `CLOSE`. We should bump conntrack table and inspect kernel drop counters: `cat /proc/net/nf_conntrack_count` shows spikes.

jess-runner: ops note — draining 6 nodes from rack-7 will move ~20 jobs, ETA 20-30m. Cost estimate: extra cross-AZ egress ~ $2.5k/day if this persists.

kira-oncall: I've opened an escalation with hardware vendor — case #HW-4992 — and added packet captures and logs. Also creating an RFC to add per-rack LB affinity and a postmortem runbook for ToR firmware rollouts.

tina-net: update — rollback finished at 1803456888, hash behavior looks stable again. MTU mismatch still present on ~3 leaf ports; coordinating pod-level MTU bump + scheduled maintenance window to fix cabling/ASIC config.

samir-sre: status: cordon/drain in progress, autoscaler muted for 1h (owner: max-ops). We'll keep the rack in maintenance mode until vendor confirms fix.

jess-runner: thanks everyone. Summary action items: 1) vendor escalation (kira), 2) full ToR validation sweep and port MTU remediations in maintenance window (tina), 3) workstation/infra autoscaler policy review to prevent cross-AZ scale (samir+max), 4) add per-rack LB affinity flag to infra roadmap (product).

max-ops: I'll follow up with an incident doc and cost impact calc. Will post updates in #incidents if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
